items.title: Not Feeling Confident
items.text:
Not Feeling Confident
It’s been a while since I’ve been on. So here’s a quick history:
Struggled to get pregnant for 3 years- failed Clomid cycle and 2 IUIS. Then was diagnosed with low AMH and high FSH. 

Round 1 of IVF resulted in 0 blasts. Diagnosis changed to DOR.

Round 2 was canceled due to a dominant follicle .

Round 3 was a success! Two blasts, one PGS normal. FET in October 2016 and that little guy is almost 2 now.

Fast forward to now. My period was late so I took a test on Sunday and it was positive!!! I almost fainted! What a pleasant surprise! I’ve been testing every morning since and the lines are getting darker. But I’m trying to be realistic about the chances of a spontaneous low AMH pregnancy actually making it to viability. 

My HCG results came in today. 156.  At 4 weeks and 4 days pregnant, I’m thinking 156 is pretty low. With my previous pregnancy I was at 795hcg at 4+4. They also said my progesterone is slightly low so I’m being put on suppositories. 

I’m just feeling bummed and hopeless after getting these results. I guess I’m just looking for support from people who get it.

Thank you! This really helps so much! It was a total surprise. I chose not to test ovulation during this last cycle because I just needed a break from obsessing over my cycles. We had sex on cycle day 15... which is kind of late because I typically ovulate on days 10-12. I was just hoping for more confirmation from that number I guess.
Not with a test. See above ^ I took this month off from testing ovulation but I usually get a positive opk on days 10-12. We had sex on day 15. So I would have HAD to ovulate late.
Thank you!
On it! Thank you!
You’re my favorite person right now. Thank you!

Thank you so much! I’m crying just reading all these comments. (Infertility sucks!!) I knew I could count on this group to make me feel less hopeful. I hope I get to join you on the miraculous pregnancy journey!
Thank you! Just hoping for a doubling beta. Going in tomorrow morning for the second blood draw.

Just had blood drawn for a second beta. I’m TERRIFIED! But the lines on my pregnancy tests were dark & solid today. So that’s promising, right? Since Sunday they’ve been getting darker & darker. Results won’t be in til tomorrow. Ahhh!
Also, I must tell you CONGRATULATIONS!!! I haven’t stopped thinking about your story and feeling so excited & happy for you. How amazing to get that spontaneous baby. Yay!!!!
Yessss! The waiting is pure hell! When is your ultrasound?
And the days just drag on and on. It’s the worst!
How far along will you be on Monday?
I know! We could do same-day but it’s not covered by insurance.
That is really early for an ultrasound. You’ll barely be 5 weeks. I didn’t think they could really see much of anything at that point. How are your HCG levels?
Haha! I’ll try!
Whoooo! Nice numbers!!! Good luck!

Thank you so very much! And congratulations on a positive! When did you post about your beta? I’d love to go read through the low beta success stories. 

Hubs just picked up PIO. I opted to do injections because I can’t stand vaginal goo. 🤣

When is your ultrasound?

Thank you so much!! I checked out the post and read it to my husband. I’m feeling more hopeful about today’s phone call. That’s exactly what I needed. 

PIO really isn’t that bad. I was giving them to myself like a champ with our IVF pregnancy. I just wasn’t expecting to be doing it again so soon. It’s bringing on a flood of memories. 

If I get to the 7-week ultrasound it’ll be on April 26. Not too far from you. I’m hoping and crossing fingers that we get good results and become due date (or close to it) buddies!

I’m on the same timeline as you. Found out I was pregnant on the 7th. And I’m having no symptoms. I keep thinking how weird it is that I’m not feeling tired. With my last pregnancy, I had very few symptoms, as well. It was just an easy, breezy pregnancy. My boobs never even hurt or felt sensitive. So you could just be one of those super lucky women who has a unicorn pregnancy. 😁 

Also, I’m shocked that they have already done an ultrasound. It’s a little early and rare to see a heartbeat so soon. From my understanding, they usually do the first scan at 7 weeks.

Just curious, what were your betas and are you on progesterone?

Oh! I also wanted to add that I had some light brownish/pink spotting very early with my last IVF pregnancy and I just knew it was over. I texted my best friend and just cried. He’s almost 2 now. So don’t stress too much over the bleeding unless it’s bright red or gets really heavy.

I’m calling bullshit on your doctor! I’m taking PIO and it’s not an IVF pregnancy. I’ve somehow become pregnant naturally (after 3 years and 3 rounds of IVF to have my first). I contacted my RE because I’d prefer their care and attention especially with the anxiety I’m having over this actually working. They’re doing my betas and will be doing the first ultrasound. The nurse sent in a prescription for progesterone suppositories because mine came back a little low. I asked if I could do injections instead. She sent the prescription over and I started them that night. You have the right to choose what you want!

Good news! My beta more than doubled! 
First beta- 156
Second beta- 490

I go in for the third on Monday morning. Ahhhh!!! I'm still in shock and disbelief. And my butt is a little sore from the PIO. But I'll do it forever if it means I get a healthy baby.

I had these exact feelings after my son was born. We worked so hard to get him and I finally felt complete but my head kept imagining the worst-case scenario of every little thing. The good news is that it did get better. Your hormones are all over the place and you're still recovering from birth. I'm less anxious now than I was right after he was born but I will say that I'm much more anxious as a mom than I ever was before. I've talked to other moms who didn't struggle with infertility and they are experiencing the same thing. I think it's just part of being a mom. 

Keep an eye on it. Take deep breaths and count to 10. Talk to someone you trust about it. And if it seems to be getting out of control, go see someone. But I think what you're feeling at the moment is probably normal but with extra worry since you worked so hard to have this sweet baby. Enjoy those snuggles!

That is really strange that they didn't check to see if it was doubling. But that's a really high first beta so maybe he was content with it?

My beta was extremely low which set me into a panic and tears for a whole day. But it doubled so I'm in the clear for now. It was 156 on Tuesday, 490 on Thursday. I go back Monday for a third check. 

I am on progesterone. Doing injections cause who wants a gooey, moist vagina? :) 

Yes! Let's definitely keep in touch and keep each other sane. I had a panic attack at work yesterday due to the anxiety of waiting for results. It was terrible!
Oh my! That timing is awful. Crossing fingers for a good ultrasound. Nothing is worse than that wait.
Ha! Best feeling ever!!

I'm having a minor freakout. I started feeling really bad last night. Achy back, nauseous, chills. I went to the bathroom just before getting in bed cause I just felt so horrible. And there was blood! I wiped several times to make sure I wasn't seeing things and then started crying when the toilet paper kept showing bright pink. 

I basically went straight to sleep after that terrified of what this could mean. I was having mild cramping and chills. Which made me think it definitely had to be a miscarriage.

I called the clinic this morning and they woke my nurse up to call me back. The good news is that I'm not having any bleeding at the moment and had very little spotting through the night. My nurse decided to move my 3rd beta to this morning. (It was scheduled for tomorrow). They're going to check hcg and progesterone to see what's going on. I should know by 12 or 1 today what the results are and we'll go from there. 

She said that it could just be dehydration since I was having the cramping. Apparently, dehydration in early pregnancy can cause cramping and bleeding. So I'm chugging water like there's no tomorrow.

In all the years of infertility and treatment, I've heard the success stories of people who had early bleeds and went on to have a successful pregnancy. So I'm using that knowledge to think rationally but it's so hard not to expect doom. 

Cross your fingers, hope, pray, send good vibes. Whatever it is you do, please do it for me! I'm so scared.

Update: 3rd beta came back. Not even close to doubling and it has been 72 hours. 

Beta 1- 156; Beta 2- 490; Beta 3- 643

I’m not spotting or bleeding anymore. But I’m still having minor cramps and I just have a feeling the progesterone is preventing the inevitable. I go back Tuesday for another HCG draw. I’m sick of this roller coaster.
That’s awesome!! Congratulations!

That first day of daycare is so rough! I was super anxious for the first few months. I just couldn’t get used to leaving this baby we worked so hard for each day. But it does it easier. How’d she do? And how were the results?
Whooooaaaa! That’s crazy!

Back at the RE to continue the beta roller coaster. Since the pink spotting on Saturday, I’ve had a little bit of brown. I mean... so little I probably wouldn’t have noticed if I wasn’t inspecting my panties every hour.  The cramping has completely stopped and I feel fantastic! 

Maybe the numbers will have jumped up? But let’s be real. A natural pregnancy actually lasting probably isn’t in the books for me. So ready to get answers!
Thinking of you! And YAY for a boy! They’re the best 😁
Fingers crossed!!!

items.title: Bad News
items.text:
Bad News
My beta came back at 170 today.

156, 490, 643, 170

RE says I should start bleeding in the next few days and to come back over the weekend so they can track my beta back to zero. 

I’m still in shock over the fact that we actually got pregnant naturally and now I’m trying to process the fact that I’m having a miscarriage. I don’t even know how to feel. I’m still somewhat excited and proud of my ovaries. But I don’t ever want to experience this again! This is pure hell.

Thanks for all the kind words and support. You ladies (and gents) are the ABSOLUTE best! 

One last thing- why did the cramping and spotting stop? I just knew it was happening Saturday but then it stopped and I’ve felt great ever since. My body is really messing with me!
Thank you! That really means a lot. I can’t imagine two weeks of riding betas. Argh!!! That’s just cruel!
babyonhold.blogspot.com
Check out these vloggers on YouTube: Phil & Alex, Ayla & Caleb

Of course! 
Test 1- 156- was drawn 18 dpo 
Test 2- 490- was drawn 48 hours later (20 dpo)
Test 3- 643- was drawn 72 hours later (23 dpo)
Test 4 -170- was drawn 48 hours later (25 dpo) 

I’m actually in the waiting room for test 5 now. They want to track it back down to 0 before doing anymore more treatment or consultations. 😔 Bleeding started yesterday.

Have you ever listened to Dr. Aimee’s podcast? If not, go check it out or look her up on YouTube. She’s Dr. Aimee the Egg Whisperer. I just listened to a few episodes this morning and she talks about sperm health a lot. Things about men taking CoQ10, vitamin D, and Vitamin C. She even talked about coffee and antioxidants. You should definitely go check it out!
Never in person!!! Ugh. I’m so sorry.

Nope to birth control! We’re just using the family planning method. Tracking cycles and avoiding ovulation (originally). We talked and decided we didn’t really mind accidentally getting pregnant. So we avoided sex during ovulation for 2-3 months then stopped paying attention to it after that. 

Also, beware that you will ovulate before your cycle starts back! I was 8 months postpartum and kept feeling twinges in my ovaries. I also had other ovulation symptoms so I bought a kit and tested when I got home that day. POSITIVE! My first period since baby started exactly 2 weeks later.
Yesss!!! This happened to us during our 2nd cycle and we had to pay $4,000+ out of pocket. I cried more that time than I did when our first round failed with 0 embryos making it to blast.
